# T01 — Wheel rotation, mesh quality and numerical averaging

Research: TinyFish search and fetch, 2026-11-01; installed OpenFOAM v2606 source checks.

## Wheel boundary condition
- [OpenFOAM rotatingWallVelocity](https://doc.openfoam.com/2312/tools/processing/boundary-conditions/rtm/derived/wall/rotatingWallVelocity/): origin, axis and angular rate define a moving wall. The docs' Function1<vector> notation is inconsistent with the scalar omega in the installed implementation; generated cases use its scalar angular rate.
- [Wheel modelling report, Chalmers](https://www.tfd.chalmers.se/~hani/kurser/OS_CFD_2020/ErikJosefsson/Report_Erik_Josefsson.pdf): research lead for reviewer discussion of rotating-wall limitations; not used as proof that rotating-wall steady RANS resolves transient wheel wakes.
- Installed v2606 `src/finiteVolume/fields/fvPatchFields/derived/rotatingWallVelocity`: verify sign against the actual implementation and a contact-point cross product. With +y axis and contact vector -r*z, omega must be -U/r for +x moving ground.

## Explicit quality limits
- [OpenFOAM mesh quality](https://doc.openfoam.com/2312/tools/pre-processing/mesh/generation/snappyhexmesh/meshquality/): meanings and values of the requested mesh limits. Write the task's values locally with minArea/minTriangleTwist -1, matching installed v2606 defaults, rather than relying on a changing etc include.
- Installed v2606 `etc/caseDicts/mesh/generation/meshQualityDict.cfg` and motorBike meshQualityDict: compared defaults. No relaxed dictionary is added, and any checkMesh failure remains a rejection.

## Run control and mean uncertainty
- [OpenFOAM runTimeControl](https://doc.openfoam.com/2306/tools/post-processing/function-objects/utilities/runTimeControl/): same-group conditions combine with AND. Couple the Cd averaging stop condition to a 1000-iteration maxDuration condition; omit SIMPLE residualControl in averaged mode so it cannot bypass the minimum.
- [Batch means teaching notes](https://www.eg.bucknell.edu/~xmeng/Course/CS6337/Note/master/node88.html): cautions on estimating correlation from few batches. Ten batches are required by T01, not a universal guarantee of interval coverage.
- Implementation decision: Student-t(9) batch-mean interval, variance inflated by (1+rho)/(1-rho) for positive lag-1 correlation between batch means. Negative correlation cannot shrink the independent estimate. This is an approximate numerical-iteration screening statistic, not a measured physical confidence interval or transient validation.
